name: Eventcube
shortDescription: A UK-developed service for tickets to free or paid in-person, online and hybrid events. It uses Stripe payments and offers branded pages and QR-code check-in.
suitableContexts: Churches running free or paid public events
Conference, training or hybrid-event teams that need branded ticketing
Organisations already using Stripe for ticket payment

pricing.summary: The Starter ticketing plan has no monthly charge and a published 5% Eventcube fee on paid-ticket transaction totals; free tickets are stated to be free of Eventcube fees. Pro is published at $99/month billed annually or $125/month monthly, plus a 3% ticket fee. Stripe processing fees and VAT are additional considerations.

tiers.label: Starter
tiers.price: No monthly charge; 5% of paid-ticket transaction total
tiers.detail: Supplier states free tickets do not incur Eventcube fees; Stripe processing fees apply

tiers.label: Pro
tiers.price: $99/month annually or $125/month monthly; 3% of paid-ticket transaction total
tiers.detail: Supplier publishes additional branding and event features; UK prices and percentages exclude VAT

dataHosting: Eventcube's privacy policy says some third-party processing may take place outside the UK. Ask for the current subprocessor list, hosting locations, transfer safeguards, retention schedule and data-processing terms before use.
gdprInformation: The supplier publishes a UK privacy policy and terms that refer to UK data-protection legislation. Its privacy policy was last updated in April 2021, so a church should obtain current contractual data-processing information as part of procurement.
coreFeatures: Custom ticket stores and booking fees
QR ticket validation and mobile check-in
Waitlists, discounts and event pages according to supplier feature information
White-label and custom-domain options on higher plans
integrations: Zoom, Microsoft Teams and other third-party platforms for relevant virtual-event plans according to the supplier
Bespoke payment gateways on Enterprise according to the supplier
importExport: Establish the available attendee, financial and reporting exports in a live account or supplier demonstration
Agree the exit process for event and customer data before adoption
support: Supplier directs customers to its support centre
Enhanced support is listed for Pro in the supplier's published fee guidance

uk-purchasing.value: Eventcube Solutions Ltd is an active UK private limited company, number 08939283, and its published pricing expressly addresses UK VAT.

transfers.value: Supplier privacy policy says that some external third parties are based outside the UK and describes transfer safeguards at a high level.

ticket-pricing.value: Supplier publishes a 5% Starter fee for paid tickets, free Eventcube fees for free tickets, and a Pro option with a 3% fee plus monthly USD subscription pricing.

ticketing-terms.value: Supplier terms describe a white-label online event-management and ticketing system for event organisers, with transaction and payment processing arrangements.

editorial.assessment: Eventcube is a general event platform rather than church software, but it can suit churches that run public conferences, ticketed events or online and hybrid programmes. Its no-monthly-charge Starter plan can make occasional paid events practical, while its 5% platform fee and separate Stripe fee need pricing against a real ticket mix. Treat it as an event-operation tool: it does not replace church people records, Gift Aid workflows or safeguarding administration.
bestFor: Free or paid public church events using Stripe
Church conferences and training events needing flexible ticket pages and QR check-in
Teams that may later need a branded or white-label event store
strengths: Active UK company with published platform terms and public ticket-fee structure
Free tickets and a no-monthly-charge Starter option
Ticketing, registration, booking-fee and QR check-in workflow documented by the supplier
limitations: Not purpose-built for churches, Gift Aid administration, volunteer rotas or safeguarding records
Paid ticket pricing combines Eventcube fees, Stripe fees and potentially VAT
Published privacy policy notes overseas third-party processing and is dated April 2021

procurementVerdict.problem: Publishing and operating paid or free church events without building a bespoke booking journey
procurementVerdict.differentiator: A UK-developed general event platform with a free-ticket route, Stripe payment flow and configurable ticket-store options
procurementVerdict.firstCheck: Build a real free and paid event, test the booking fee, refund and QR scan journey, and obtain current data-processing and export terms
